text: こんな　すごい　ニュースを　みたのは　ひさしぶり　じゃわい！

structure.jp: こんな　すごい　ニュースを　みたのは
ひさしぶり　じゃわい！
structure.en: is the first time in ages!

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. みたのは = 'having seen it (is...)'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is'. ひさしぶり　じゃ = 'it is the first time in a long while'.

patterns.name: 〜わい
patterns.explanation: わい at the end is an old-man way of adding feeling, like 'I tell you'. じゃわい = 'it is, I tell you!'.
